note: The events are Vigie's own grouping (ADR 0012): `title`, `level`, `areas_count`, the period and `bbox` are worked out (listed in `derived`); the warnings and hazards inside are as their sources gave them. A source that does not answer is in `coverage`: its warnings are missing, which is not "nothing in force". A MeteoAlarm warning has its words once its CAP document is read (at most 40 new ones per request). This is not an official warning service: follow the warnings of your national authorities.
